author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I need to address a vertical drywall inside corner, but there’s a small gap. So I’m using Strait-Flex Perfect-90 because it’s reinforced and stronger than paper tape. Plus, the laminated coating can be primed and painted, which speeds up the finishing process.
